revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a utility-room passage. Scene includes cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor and wall tiles, warm practical interior lighting. Right-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A middle-aged woman with a sturdy build is clearly visible, wearing dark work trousers and a muted green jacket with brown and cream clothing elements, sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal and upright enough to show supported seated posture. Composition should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, with a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
